description: This file defines a React component 'ImageEditorField' for uploading, cropping, and displaying images or avatars within a React-Admin application. It includes an associated dialog component for image editing with cropper.js integration, dropzone for file uploads, and UI components from Material-UI.

methods.name: ImageEditorField
methods.description: Main component to display an image or avatar with click-to-edit functionality via a dialog.

methods.name: ImageEditorDialog
methods.description: Dialog component allowing users to upload, crop, update, or delete images with cropper functionality.
